name: Downward Facing Balance
instructions: Lie facedown on top of an exercise ball.
While resting on your stomach on the ball, walk your hands forward along the floor and lift your legs, extending your elbows and knees.
prompt: This is a Downward Facing Balance for strength that uses static force to primarily train the glutes. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Lie facedown on top of an exercise ball. While resting on your stomach on the ball, walk your hands forward along the floor and lift your legs, extending your elbows and knees."
